title: docs(README): the root README's "Kanban Board" example authors a column shape the validator refuses — missing `id` / `title` / `cards`, and a `color` that is a named refusal since #7664 (docs half of #7742, immediately actionable)
body:
Filed by the director seat under the #7742 ruling (decision batch #70, 2026-09-07). Not blocked on #7742's contract rows — the fix is unambiguous today.

## Measured (triage on #7742, `origin/main` `0558e0f`)

- `README.md:309-318` — `"type": "kanban"`, `"titleField": "title"`, `columns: [{ "value": "todo", "label": "To Do", "color": "#6366f1" }, …]`.
- `packages/types/src/zod/complex.zod.ts:95-97` — `KanbanColumnSchema` requires `id`, `title`, `cards`; `:101` — `color` is `retiredDeclarativeKanbanKey('color', 'column', 'Style a lane through its `className`.')`.

⇒ The example fails `safeValidateSchema` outright (three required keys absent, one named refusal present). No gate reads the root README's `json` fences, so it stayed green.

## Scope

- Rewrite the example with `KanbanColumnSchema`'s `{ id, title, cards }` shape, `className` instead of `color`, and `cardTitle` instead of `titleField` (the `kanban` arm's one spelling per #7742's ruling).
- Consider a fenced-block gate for the root README (`json` fences validated like `content/docs`) as a separate devx card if the docs-gate owner agrees; not in scope here.
- `skip-changeset`.

## Acceptance

- [ ] the example validates against `KanbanSchema` (paste it through `safeValidateSchema` in a test or record the run here)

Refs #7742, #7664.
